description: The North Greece road-safety research team publishes the BSNG dataset for classifying traffic-accident blackspots. The describing article assembles police and statistical accident observations for Macedonia and Thrace during 2014–2018 and explains how locations become blackspot examples. GitHub identifies the named dataset and applies an MIT licence, whereas the article gives a non-commercial Creative Commons label; the repository licence is recorded with that difference retained. Public access is free. These regional examples can inform road-risk simulations or evaluate blackspot classification. The repository README is brief, and the study period and regional reporting process are limitations on transfer. File encoding and individual accident records were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: North Greece traffic accident blackspot dataset
notes: G4-0477; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
